criterion: which assistant-command intent the utterance expresses, that is what the user wants done

categories.name: Add To Playlist
categories.definition: User wants to add a specific track, artist, album, or item to a specified music playlist.

categories.name: Book Restaurant
categories.definition: User wants to make a reservation or book a table at a restaurant or eating establishment.

categories.name: Find Creative Work
categories.definition: User wants to locate, search for, or find a specific creative work such as a movie, TV series, book, game, album, or photograph.

categories.name: Get Weather
categories.definition: User wants to know the weather forecast or specific weather conditions for a location and time.

categories.name: Play Music
categories.definition: User wants to play music, a song, an album, an artist, or a playlist on a music service.

categories.name: Rate Item
categories.definition: User wants to assign a rating, score, or star value to a specific item such as a book, movie, or album.

categories.name: Show Movie Schedule
categories.definition: User wants to see movie schedules, showtimes, or what movies are playing at a specific theater or in a specific area.
